As a warehouse employee at Zara in Enschede, you make sure all products are neatly and timely stored in the warehouse. You work 3 to 8 hours per week, split between Monday mornings and Thursday afternoons. Working hours are from 7:00 to 12:00 and from 16:00 to 19:00. This job is perfect if you want flexible hours alongside your studies or another job. You join an enthusiastic team and take responsibility for your own tasks.
You start your day by unpacking deliveries. You sort clothing and accessories and put everything in the right place in the warehouse. After that, you make sure the store always has enough stock. At the end of your shift, you help keep the warehouse tidy. You stay active the whole time and work together with your colleagues.
This job suits you if you want flexible work and enjoy being part of a team. Experience is not required. Apply quickly and make a difference in the heart of Enschede! ✨

- Experience is not required, but is a plus
- You are physically fit and like to take initiative
- Able to work independently and in a team
- You speak Dutch or English

If you like being active and want to see your balance of your bank account grow every week, this is your chance! Earn up to € 22.49 gross per hour while working in an energetic, international team. You don’t have to go to the gym anymore, your workout starts here! Sounds good right!? Read on to see what else we offer!

What we offer
- A salary of € 14.99 per hour (18+)
- Allowances up to € 22.49 per hour!
- Travel allowance (€ 0.23 per km)
- Getting paid every week
- A working atmosphere that scores an 8+
- Chance on a fixed contract after just 12 weeks!

Who you are
First of all, you don’t like to sit still! If you like working with your hands, this is the perfect job for you! As a Logistics Employee, you are the reason all those packages arrive on time!
Furthermore, you meet the following requirements:

- You are at 18 years old or older  (safety first!)
- You are available for 5 days a week
- You can work in a rotational shift in the afternoon and in the night
- You understand and speak English or Dutch
- You have a car, bike or scooter to get to DPD in Oirschot

What will you do
Get ready for action! As a Logistics Employee you’ll be loading and unloading trucks and sorting packages by hand. You’re constantly moving so you will stay fit while you work. It’s like getting paid to exercise! Together with your colleagues, you make sure the process runs smoothly. It’s hard work, but the result (and the paycheck) makes it totally worth it!

The working days are divided in rotational shifts from Monday to Sunday (we’ll plan it together)

- Afternoon: 14:00 - 22:30
- Night: 22:30 - 07:00

Where will you work
You’ll be working at the DPD depot in Oirschot, located at ‘Pakket onderweg 1’. It’s a modern hub where Logistics Employees from all over the world come together. There’s plenty of time to chat or joke with your colleagues. We don’t just offer a job; we offer a place with a good environment where you can grow. Do you have the ambition to lead a team? Are you ready for a logistics role with real responsibility? 🚀 Where you don't just work on the floor, but also handle system administration on the PC and mentor new colleagues? Become a Senior Warehouse Operator at Samsung SDS! You will earn a great starting wage of €15,- per hour. Read on and apply today!

What we offer
- An hourly wage of €15,-!
- Steady hours in dayshift!
- A great employer in Breda!
- Weekly payout of your salary
- Free training to obtain MHE certificates!
- Growth opportunities toward coordinator!

Who you are
To get started as a warehouse operator, it is important that you meet the following requirements:

- You speak and write English fluently.
- You have at least 1 year of work experience in logistics.
- You are computer literate and skilled with system administration.
- You are available full-time to work in shifts
- You hold a valid MHE certificate or are willing to obtain one
- You are physically able to handle heavy items
- You can work at the job location in Breda

What will you do
As a warehouse operator at Samsung SDS, no two days are the same! You are much more than an average warehouse worker. One moment you ride MHE equipment to shift inventory, and the next you operate the system to inspect and process RMA returns.

- You accurately inspect and register returned goods (RMA) into the computer system.
- You drive MHE equipment safely to transport items through the warehouse.

Where will you work
You will join an energetic, high-performing logistics team at Samsung SDS. Here, you work closely with supervisors and coordinators to hit key targets.

- Work at a world-renowned global logistics leader.
- Perfect mix of physical warehouse tasks and system management.
- Strong team spirit with short communication lines.
